blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Three-dimensional multi-echo MRI provides rich anatomical and quantitative information, but repeated volumetric encoding prolongs acquisition and motivates k-space undersampling.
Reconstructing undersampled multi-echo data requires exploiting shared anatomy while preserving echo-dependent signal variation; full-volume modeling also introduces substantial computational and memory demands.
We propose MIGA, a scan-specific framework comprising shared anisotropic Gaussian geometry, a coordinate-conditioned multi-output amplitude network, and explicit echo-specific phase variables.
The Gaussian geometry provides common spatial support across echoes, the implicit network models spatially structured amplitude variations, and the phase variables retain echo-specific complex signal information.
All components are jointly optimized using only the acquired multi-coil k-space, requiring no fully sampled training data.
Experiments showed that MIGA consistently outperformed the comparison methods across imaging tasks and acceleration factors, with larger improvements under stronger undersampling.
MIGA also achieved a favorable quality–cost balance among the evaluated full-volume multi-echo methods.
These results support the effectiveness of combining shared Gaussian geometry with implicit echo-dependent amplitude modeling for accelerated 3D multi-echo MRI reconstruction.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Three-dimensional multi-echo MRI acquires a series of volumetric images with complementary tissue contrasts in a single examination. These images provide rich anatomical information and characterize echo-dependent signal evolution for subsequent quantitative assessment [ 1 , 2 ] . However, repeated phase and partition encoding across echoes substantially increases acquisition time [ 3 ] . Although k-space undersampling can accelerate acquisition, it makes the recovery of complex volumes more ill-posed [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 三维多电子 核磁共振在一次检查中获得了一系列具有互补组织对比的体积图像. 这些图像提供了丰富的解剖信息,为后续定量评估[1,2]定性了依赖回声的信号演化. 然而,重复的相位和横跨回声的分区编码大大增加了获取时间[3]. 虽然k-空格下采样可以加速获取,但是它使得复杂卷的恢复更不可靠[4].

blocks.en: Recent accelerated MRI reconstruction methods differ primarily in how reconstruction priors are represented and learned. Classical methods combine the acquisition model with sparsity, low-rankness, or other handcrafted priors [ 5 , 6 ] . These methods are interpretable but may inadequately capture complex image structures and inter-echo dependencies. Supervised deep networks learn expressive population priors and provide fast inference [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] , but require matched training data and may be sensitive to acquisition shifts [ 10 ] . More recently, self-supervised and scan-specific approaches learn directly from undersampled measurements or individual acquisitions [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] , reducing dependence on fully sampled training data. For 3D multi-echo MRI, directly reconstructing all echoes as full volumes preserves spatial and inter-echo dependencies but entails substantial computational and memory costs. To reduce this burden, existing methods commonly compress echo-dependent signals using subspace or tensor models [ 14 , 15 , 16 ] , or process the volume as a series of two-dimensional slices [ 17 ] . However, low-dimensional assumptions may not adequately represent complex echo-dependent signal evolution, while slice-wise processing weakens inter-slice consistency and does not fully exploit three-dimensional anatomical structure. A representation that combines volumetric consistency, flexible echo-dependent modeling, and manageable computational cost is therefore still needed.
blocks.zh: 最近加速的核磁共振重建方法主要在如何反映和学习重建历程方面有所不同。 古典化的方法结合了获取模型与斯帕氏,低阶,或者其他手工前科[5,6]. 这些方法是可以解释的,但可能无法充分捕捉复杂的图像结构和生态之间的依赖。 监管的深层网络学习表现性人群前科,提供快速推论[7,8,9],但需要匹配的培训数据,可能对获取班次敏感[10]. 最近,自我监督和扫描特定方法直接从抽样不足的测量或个人获取[11、12、13]中学习,减少对充分抽样培训数据的依赖。 对于3D多echo核磁共振,直接重建所有回声,因为全量保留空间和生态间依赖性,但需要大量的计算和内存成本。 为了减轻这种负担,现有方法通常使用子空间或拉伸模型[14,15,16]来压缩依赖回声的信号,或者将音量处理为一系列二维切片[17]. 然而,低维假设可能不足以代表复杂的依赖回声的信号演化,而切片处理则削弱切片间的一致性,不能充分利用三维解剖结构. 因此,仍然需要一种将量性一致性、灵活依赖回声的模型和可控计算成本结合起来的表述。

blocks.en: Beyond these general reconstruction challenges, multi-echo MRI presents a specific representation problem. Spatially aligned echoes share the same underlying anatomy but exhibit echo-dependent signal amplitudes and phases. Reconstructing each echo independently preserves appearance flexibility but repeatedly estimates common anatomical structure and does not fully exploit complementary information across echoes. An effective representation should therefore encode shared anatomical geometry while retaining flexible echo-specific complex appearance. The appearance parameters should also be appropriately structured to exploit spatial and inter-echo dependencies and regularize the undersampled inverse problem.
blocks.zh: 除了这些一般的重建挑战之外,多生态核磁共振还提出了具体的代表性问题。 空间对齐的回声具有相同的基础解剖学,但显示出依赖回声的信号振幅和相位。 重建每个回声独立保持外观灵活性,但反复估计常见解剖结构,没有充分利用跨回声的补充信息. 因此,有效的表示应编码共享解剖几何,同时保留灵活的回声特定复杂外观。 外观参数还应加以适当结构,以利用空间和生态之间的依赖性,并使所抽样的反向问题正规化。

blocks.en: Gaussian splatting offers a structured and computationally tractable representation for full-volume reconstruction. Learnable anisotropic Gaussian primitives provide localized continuous support and can be efficiently evaluated through differentiable rasterization [ 18 ] . Extending this representation to complex-valued MRI enables direct optimization from undersampled k-space [ 19 ] . For multi-echo reconstruction, sharing Gaussian positions, scales, and rotations encodes common anatomical geometry and reduces redundant per-echo parameterization. However, independently optimizing the amplitude of each Gaussian and echo leaves the appearance parameters weakly coupled and does not explicitly capture spatial or inter-echo dependencies, limiting robustness under severe undersampling. This motivates combining shared Gaussian geometry with a shared implicit function that models spatially structured, echo-dependent amplitudes, while retaining explicit echo-specific phase variables to preserve complex signal variation.
blocks.zh: 高斯电镀为全容量重建提供了结构化和可计算可拉动的表示. 可学习的异同位素高斯原始人提供局部的连续支持,并且可以通过不同的光栅化来有效评价[18]. 将这种表示扩展至复杂值的磁共振,可以直接优化来自未加取样的k-空间[19]。 对于多echo重建,共享高斯位置,鳞片,旋转编码常见的解剖几何,减少每个echo参数的冗余. 然而,独立优化每个高斯琴和回声的振幅,使得外观参数的结合度微弱,并且没有明确捕捉空间或生态间依赖性,在严重下采样下限制了稳健性. 这激励将共享的高斯几何与共享的隐含功能相结合,在空间结构上模拟,依赖回声的振幅,同时保留明确的回声特定相变,以保存复杂的信号变异.

blocks.en: We propose Multi-Echo Implicit Gaussian Amplitudes (MIGA), a scan-specific framework for accelerated 3D multi-echo MRI reconstruction. MIGA organizes the multi-echo representation into shared anisotropic Gaussian geometry, implicitly modeled echo-dependent amplitudes, and explicit echo-specific phases. The shared geometry encodes common anatomical support, whereas a coordinate-conditioned multi-output network couples amplitude estimation across space and echoes. Explicit phase variables preserve echo-dependent complex signal information. All representation parameters are jointly optimized directly from the acquired multi-coil k-space, enabling scan-specific reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 我们提出多Echo隐含高斯海角(MIGA),这是加速3D多echo核磁共振重建的扫描专用框架. MIGA将多echo代表物组织成共享的异构高斯几何,含蓄地模拟了依赖回声的振幅,并明确了回声的特定阶段. 共享的几何编码是常见的解剖支持,而协调的多输出网络夫妇则在空间和回声中振幅估计。 明确的相位变量保存着依赖回声的复杂信号信息. 所有代表参数都直接从获得的多油K-空间中联合优化,从而能够进行特定扫描重建。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows: 1. We introduce a complex-valued 3D multi-echo Gaussian representation that shares Gaussian positions, scales, and rotations across echoes to encode common anatomical geometry while retaining echo-specific amplitudes and phases. 2. We develop a coordinate-conditioned multi-output amplitude model that structures amplitude estimation across space and echoes. Combined with explicit echo-specific phases, this design balances cross-echo regularization with flexible complex appearance modeling. 3. We integrate the proposed representation into a scan-specific framework optimized directly from acquired multi-coil k-space, requiring no external training data. Retrospective and prospective experiments demonstrate consistent improvements across imaging tasks and acceleration factors, with larger gains under stronger undersampling and a favorable quality–cost balance among the evaluated full-volume methods.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下: 1. 我们引入了一种复杂值的3D多层高斯代表,共享高斯位置,天平,以及跨回声的旋转,以编码常见解剖几何,同时保留回声特定的振幅和相位. 2. 我们开发了一个具有协调条件的多输出振幅模型,该模型的结构是跨空间的振幅估计和回声。 这种设计与明确的回声特定阶段相结合,平衡了跨echo规范化和灵活的复杂外观模型。 3. 我们把拟议的代表性纳入一个扫描专项框架,直接从获得的多油K-空间得到优化,不需要外部培训数据。 回顾和预期的实验表明,在成像任务和加速因素方面,不断改进,在更强的取样下,收益更大,在所评价的全卷方法之间,质量-成本平衡更有利。

blocks.en: MIGA exploits the observation that spatially aligned echoes share anatomical structure but exhibit echo-dependent complex appearance. Accordingly, MIGA represents all echoes using shared 3D Gaussian geometry, implicitly modeled echo-dependent amplitudes, and explicit echo-specific phases. As summarized in Fig. 1 , the framework first initializes the representation from the acquired data, then jointly optimizes all parameters against measured multi-coil k-space, and finally enforces exact coil-domain consistency at acquired k-space locations. The complete reconstruction is performed independently for each acquisition without external training data.

blocks.en: III-B Comparison Methods and Evaluation Settings
blocks.zh: 三-B 比较方法和评价设置

blocks.en: Comparison methods: MIGA was compared with five representative reconstruction methods, none of which requires fully sampled training data or an externally pretrained network. ZS-SSL [ 12 ] is a zero-shot self-supervised method and was adapted to a 3D unrolled architecture for joint multi-echo reconstruction. ConvDecoder [ 13 ] is a deep-image-prior method and was implemented as a 3D convolutional generator with multi-echo outputs. LRTFR [ 16 ] is a functional tensor representation; our implementation jointly modeled 3D multi-echo volumes using a learnable core tensor and coordinate-dependent SIREN factors [ 30 ] , without rank reduction. INR [ 17 ] is a 2D coordinate-based implicit neural representation using hash encoding. After an inverse Fourier transform along the fully sampled readout direction, an independent INR was optimized for each resulting 2D slice to jointly reconstruct all echoes. PICS [ 5 ] is a conventional compressed-sensing method and was implemented in BART to reconstruct each 3D echo independently using wavelet and TV regularization.
blocks.zh: 比较方法:将多边投资担保机构与5种有代表性的重建方法进行比较,其中没有任何一种方法需要经过充分抽样的培训数据或外部预先培训的网络。 ZS-SSL [12] 是一种零镜头自控方法,被改编为3D无卷结构,用于联合多echo重建. ConvDecoder [13] 是一种深映射先导方法,作为具有多echo输出的3D转录生成器执行. LRTFR [16] 是一个功能性变压器代表;我们的执行使用可学习的核心变压器和依赖协调的SIREN系数[30],共同模拟了3D多echo卷,而不降低排位. INR[17]是一种使用散列编码的基于2D坐标的隐含神经表示. 在沿着完全抽样的读出方向进行反向Fourier变换后,对每个结果的2D切片都进行了独立的INR优化,以联合重建所有回声. PICS [5]是一种传统的压缩感应方法,在BART中实施,通过波浪和电视规范化独立重建每个3D回声.

blocks.en: Reconstruction settings: All methods used identical preprocessed k-space data, sampling masks, and sensitivity maps. Joint methods reconstructed the two CMRA echoes or each six-echo MTP group together, whereas PICS reconstructed each echo independently. ZS-SSL selected its checkpoint using held-out acquired samples and performed final inference using all acquired samples. All other methods used fixed iteration budgets, followed by measured-sample k-space replacement and sensitivity-weighted coil combination. ZS-SSL retained the output of its unrolled data-consistency module without additional k-space replacement. Method-specific configurations, regularization weights, and optimization parameters were adjusted separately for the CMRA and MTP tasks. All reported GPU measurements were obtained using NVIDIA A100 80-GB PCIe GPUs.
blocks.zh: 重建设置 : 所有方法都使用了相同的预处理的k空间数据,取样口罩,以及灵敏度图. 联合方法重建了两个CMRA回声或每个6个echo MTP组合,而PICS则独立重建每个回声. ZS-SSL使用所获取的样本选择了检查站,并利用所获取的所有样本进行了最后推断。 所有其他方法都使用固定的迭代预算,然后是测量-样本k-空间替换和敏感加权线圈组合。 ZS-SSL保留了其未滚动的数据一致性模块的输出而无需额外的k空间替换. 方法特定配置,规范化权重,优化参数分别根据CMRA和MTP任务进行调整. 所有报告的GPU测量数据都使用NVIDIA A100 80-GB PCIe GPU获得.

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics: Retrospective reconstruction quality was evaluated against the fully sampled reference images using peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity index (SSIM), and normalized root-mean-square error (NRMSE). Higher PSNR and SSIM and lower NRMSE indicate better agreement with the reference. The prospective MTP results were assessed visually because no fully sampled reference was available.
blocks.zh: 评价尺度: 利用峰值信号对噪比(PSNR),结构相似性指数(SSIM),以及正常化的根-正方形差错(NRMSE),对完全抽样的参考图像进行了回顾性重建质量评价. 较高的PSNR和SSIM以及较低的NRMSE表示与参考文献有更好的一致. 对中期计划的预期结果进行了目视评估,因为没有完整的抽样参考。

blocks.en: III-C Ablation Study Design
blocks.zh: III-C 读物研究设计

blocks.en: We evaluated five configurations: joint implicit reconstruction (MIGA), joint explicit reconstruction, independent implicit reconstruction, independent explicit reconstruction, and MIGA without TV regularization. Experiments used three two-echo CMRA and three 12-volume MTP datasets retrospectively undersampled at 12 × 12\times and 16 × 16\times . Joint configurations reconstructed both CMRA echoes or each six-echo MTP group together, whereas independent configurations reconstructed each echo separately.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了五个组合:联合隐含重建、联合明确重建、独立隐含重建、独立明确重建以及没有电视正规化的MIGA。 实验使用了3个双echo CMRA和3个12卷的MTP数据集,在12 × 12\时和16 × 16\时进行回溯性取样. 联合组合重建了CMRA回声或每个6个echo MTP组合,而独立组合则分别重建每个回声.

blocks.en: Geometric sharing: The effect of geometric sharing was evaluated by comparing joint and independent reconstruction with explicit amplitude parameterization. Independent explicit reconstruction optimized separate Gaussian geometry for each echo, whereas joint explicit reconstruction shared the geometry across echoes while retaining echo-specific amplitude and phase coefficients. Because both variants used the same explicit appearance representation, this comparison assessed the benefit of using shared geometry to represent common anatomy and exploit complementary measurements across echoes.
blocks.zh: 几何共享 : 通过将联合和独立重建与明显的振幅参数化进行比较,对几何分享的效果进行了评价。 独立的显式重建为每个回声优化了单独的高斯几何,而联合显式重建则共享跨回声的几何,同时保留回声特定的振幅和相位系数. 由于两种变体都使用了相同的显式表示,因此这一比较评估了使用共享几何来代表共同解剖学和利用跨回声的补充测量的优点.

blocks.en: Implicit amplitude modeling: The contribution of implicit amplitude modeling was evaluated by comparing implicit and explicit representations within both the joint and independent settings. The explicit variants directly optimized an amplitude coefficient for each Gaussian and echo, whereas the implicit variants generated these coefficients using coordinate-conditioned networks. Within each reconstruction setting, the geometry-sharing strategy and all other optimization settings remained unchanged.
blocks.zh: 隐形振幅模型: 通过比较联合和独立环境下的隐含和明确表述,评估了隐含振幅模型的作用。 显式变体直接优化了每个高斯和回声的振幅系数,而隐式变体则利用坐标条件的网络产生这些系数. 在每一重建环境内,几何共享战略和所有其他优化环境保持不变。

blocks.en: Joint versus independent implicit reconstruction: Independent implicit reconstruction optimized separate Gaussian geometry and one single-output amplitude network for each echo, whereas joint implicit reconstruction used shared geometry and a single multi-output network for all echoes within a reconstruction group. All amplitude networks took their corresponding Gaussian-center coordinates as input and used the same coordinate encoding, hidden-layer architecture, and optimization settings; at the network level, only the output dimensionality differed, from a scalar for one echo to an E E -dimensional vector for all echoes. This comparison therefore evaluated the combined effect of geometry sharing and joint multi-echo amplitude modeling rather than isolating either component.
blocks.zh: 联合与独立的隐含重建: 独立的隐含重建优化了独立的高斯几何和每个回声的单输出振幅网络,而联合隐含重建则使用共享几何和单一的多输出网络,用于重建组内的所有回声. 所有振幅网络将相应的高斯中坐标作为输入,并使用相同的坐标编码,隐藏层架构,以及优化设置;在网络级别上,只有输出维度不同,从一个回声的scalar到所有回声的E-E维向量. 因此,这一比较评价了几何分享和联合多生态振幅模型而不是孤立两个组成部分的综合效果。

blocks.en: TV regularization: The contribution of spatial regularization was evaluated by comparing MIGA with an otherwise identical variant in which the TV coefficient was set to zero. All other initialization, network, and optimization settings remained unchanged.
blocks.zh: 电视规范化: 通过将MIGA与一个原本相同的变体(电视系数定为零)相比较,对空间规范化的贡献进行了评估。 所有其他初始化、网络和优化设置保持不变。

blocks.en: IV Results
blocks.zh: 四. 结果

blocks.en: IV-A Retrospective Reconstruction Results
blocks.zh: 四-A 回顾性重建成果

Metrics were first averaged across echoes within each dataset and are reported as the mean and standard deviation across the three datasets. The best and second-best mean values are shown in bold and underlined, respectively.

For each echo, the rows present the reconstructed magnitude images, enlarged views of the region marked in the reference, and absolute-error maps. blocks.en: Table II summarizes the retrospective results on the three CMRA and three MTP datasets. MIGA achieved the best PSNR, SSIM, and NRMSE for both tasks at both acceleration factors. Its performance degraded only moderately from 12 × 12\times to 16 × 16\times , while its advantage over the comparison methods generally increased, particularly for MTP. This pattern indicates improved robustness to more severe undersampling.
blocks.zh: 表二汇总了三个CMRA和三个中期计划数据集的追溯结果。 MIGA在两个加速因子上都取得了最好的PSNR,SSIM和NRMSE两项任务. 其性能从12x12x16x16降至16x16,而对比较方法的优势普遍增加,对中期计划尤其如此。 这种模式表明,在更严重的抽样中,强度有所提高。

blocks.en: ZS-SSL and ConvDecoder were the strongest competing methods. ZS-SSL consistently ranked second on CMRA and in MTP PSNR and NRMSE, whereas ConvDecoder achieved the second-highest MTP SSIM. Both jointly reconstruct 3D multi-echo volumes, supporting the importance of exploiting volumetric structure and inter-echo correlations. However, their dense convolutional architectures introduce higher computational demands, as examined in the computational analysis.
blocks.zh: ZS-SSL和ConvDecoder是相互竞争的最强方法. ZS-SSL在CMRA以及MTP PSNR和NRMSE中一直名列第二,而ConvDecoder则实现了MTP SSIM的第二高. 两者共同重建3D多Echo体积,支持利用体积结构的重要性和Echo间的相关性. 然而,正如计算分析所审查的那样,它们的密集的演化结构引入了更高的计算要求.

blocks.en: The remaining methods showed lower performance under the evaluated conditions. LRTFR employs a factorized functional representation, INR reconstructs multi-echo images independently across 2D slices, and PICS reconstructs each echo separately using wavelet and TV priors. Their relative performance suggests that both through-plane consistency and cross-echo information sharing are important, particularly for six-echo MTP. MIGA combines these properties through shared 3D Gaussian geometry, a multi-output implicit amplitude network, and explicit echo-specific phases. The larger gains on MTP at 16 × 16\times are consistent with the complementary roles of shared anatomical support and flexible echo-dependent modeling.
blocks.zh: 其余方法显示,在评价条件下,业绩较低。 LRTFR使用一个因子化的功能代表,INR在2D片面上独立重建多echo图像,PICS使用波浪和电视前身分别重建每个回声. 他们的相对表现表明,通过飞机的一致性和跨echo信息共享都很重要,特别是对于6个echo mTP而言。 MIGA通过共享的3D高斯几何,多输出隐含的振幅网络,以及明确的回声特定阶段,将这些属性结合在一起. 16×16\时对中期计划的较大收益符合共享解剖支持和灵活依赖回声模型的互补作用.

blocks.en: The representative CMRA results in Fig. 3 show that MIGA better preserved cardiac boundaries and local anatomical transitions, with fewer residual errors in the enlarged regions. In Fig. 4 , MIGA better preserved cortical and ventricular structures while reducing the grain-like artifacts and blurring observed with the comparison methods. These visual findings agree with the quantitative results and demonstrate consistent improvements for both two-echo CMRA and six-echo MTP reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 具有代表性的CMRA结果图3显示,MIGA更好地保留了心脏边界和局部解剖过渡,在扩大的区域剩余误差减少。 以法义. 4,MIGA更好的保存了皮层和通风结构,同时减少了类似谷物的文物,并与比较方法观测到的模糊不清. 这些目视结果与定量结果一致,并表明在重建 " 双echo " CMRA和 " 6echo " 中期计划方面不断改进。

blocks.en: IV-B Prospective Reconstruction Results
blocks.zh: 四-B 未来的重建成果

blocks.en: Fig. 5: Prospective MTP reconstructions acquired with the nominal 9 × 9\times protocol (actual acceleration: 7.84 × 7.84\times ). Echoes 2 and 8 represent the two independently reconstructed six-echo groups (Echoes 1–6 and 7–12), respectively. For each echo, the upper row shows the reconstructed magnitude images, and the lower row shows enlarged views of the region marked in the zero-filled image.
blocks.zh: 图5:通过名义上的9×9\时协议(实际加速:7.84×7.84\时)获得的预期中期计划重建. Echoes 2和8分别代表两个独立重建的六Echo群体(Echoes 1-6和7-12). 对于每个回声,上行显示重建的星等图像,下行显示以零填充图像标记的区域的放大视图.

blocks.en: Figure 5 presents the results for the prospectively undersampled MTP dataset. Because no fully sampled reference was available, reconstruction quality was assessed visually, with the zero-filled reconstruction included for context.
blocks.zh: 图5列出了未来未加取样的中期计划数据集的结果。 由于没有完整的抽样参考,重建质量经过目视评估,并列入了零填充重建的背景。

blocks.en: All reconstruction methods reduced the blurring observed in the zero-filled images. ZS-SSL preserved relatively sharp boundaries but retained grain-like artifacts, whereas ConvDecoder and PICS produced smoother images with some loss of fine detail. LRTFR and INR recovered the major anatomical structures but exhibited spatially varying texture or intensity nonuniformity. MIGA provided a favorable balance between detail preservation and artifact suppression, clearly delineating cortical folds, the interhemispheric fissure, and local tissue boundaries with limited grain-like artifacts. Similar behavior was observed for Echoes 2 and 8 from the two six-echo groups. Although quantitative accuracy cannot be determined without a fully sampled reference, these results support the feasibility of MIGA for prospectively undersampled multi-echo reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 所有重建方法都减少了零填充图像中观察到的模糊度. ZS-SSL保存了相对尖锐的边界,但保留了类似谷物的文物,而ConvDecoder和PICS则制作了较为光滑的图像,并有一些细微的细节损失. LRTFR和INR恢复了主要的解剖结构,但显示出空间差异的纹理或强度不统一。 MIGA在细节保存和文物抑制之间提供了有利的平衡,明确划定了皮质折叠,半球间裂缝,以及当地组织界限,具有有限的谷物类文物. 在两个六Echo小组的Echoes 2和8中也观察到类似的行为。 虽然没有经过充分抽样的参考,无法确定数量准确性,但这些结果支持多边投资担保机构今后进行多生态重建的可行性。

blocks.en: IV-C Ablation Results
blocks.zh: 四-C 结果

blocks.en: TABLE III: Ablation results on three CMRA and three MTP datasets at retrospective acceleration factors of 12 × 12\times and 16 × 16\times . Metrics were averaged across the two CMRA echoes or 12 MTP volumes within each dataset and are reported as the mean and sample standard deviation across the three datasets. The best and second-best unrounded means in each row are shown in bold and underlined, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表三:3个CMRA和3个MTP数据集在12x12x12x12x16x16x16的回溯加速因子上的偏差结果. 每个数据集内两个CMRA回声体或12个中期计划卷的平均值,并报告为三个数据集的平均和抽样标准偏差。 每行最佳和次最佳无圆形手段分别以粗体和下划线显示。

blocks.en: Table III evaluates geometric sharing, implicit amplitude modeling, and TV regularization. Joint explicit reconstruction consistently outperformed independent explicit reconstruction across both tasks and acceleration factors, demonstrating the benefit of representing common anatomy with shared Gaussian geometry. Within both the joint and independent settings, implicit amplitude modeling also consistently improved the corresponding explicit representation, supporting its role as a structured appearance prior.
blocks.zh: 表三评价几何分享,隐含振幅模型,电视规范化. 联合明确重建在各项任务和加速因素上的业绩始终高于独立的明确重建,表明代表共同的解剖学和共同的高斯几何的优点。 在联合和独立环境下,隐含的振幅模型也不断改进相应的明确表述,支持其作为结构化的前身的作用。

blocks.en: The effect of joint implicit reconstruction was task dependent. For two-echo CMRA, MIGA achieved the best results at both acceleration factors. For six-echo MTP, independent implicit reconstruction performed better at 12 × 12\times and retained higher SSIM at 16 × 16\times , likely because its dedicated geometry and network provided greater per-echo representation capacity. At 16 × 16\times , however, MIGA achieved comparable PSNR and NRMSE, while joint explicit reconstruction showed a larger advantage over its independent counterpart than at 12 × 12\times . These results indicate a trade-off between echo-specific capacity and the regularization provided by cross-echo sharing, with the latter becoming more beneficial under stronger undersampling.
blocks.zh: 联合间接重建的效果取决于任务。 对于两个echo CMRA,MIGA在两个加速因子上都取得了最佳结果. 对于6-echo MTP,独立隐含重建在12×12\时表现较好,在16×16\时保留了更高的SSIM,这可能是因为其专用几何和网络提供了更大的每echo代表能力. 然而,在16x16时,多边投资担保机构实现了类似的PSNR和NRMSE,而联合明确的重建显示比在12x12时更具有优势。 这些结果表明,针对具体回音的能力与跨生态共享提供的规范化之间有权衡,后者在更强的抽样下变得更加有利。

blocks.en: Removing TV regularization degraded all three metrics for both tasks and acceleration factors. This confirms that TV provides a complementary spatial constraint beyond the shared Gaussian geometry and implicit amplitude representation.
blocks.zh: 取消电视规范化,就任务和加速因素而言,所有三个指标都退化了。 这证实了电视在共享的高斯几何和隐含的振幅表示之外提供了互补的空间约束.

blocks.en: TABLE IV: Computational costs of explicit and implicit Gaussian reconstruction with independent and joint echo processing. Values are the mean and sample standard deviation across the three datasets. The lowest mean in each dataset block and cost column is shown in bold.
blocks.zh: 表格 四:通过独立和联合回声处理进行明暗高斯重建的计算成本. 值是三个数据集的平均值和样本标准偏差. 每个数据集块和成本栏中的最低平均值用黑体表示。

blocks.en: Table IV summarizes the computational trade-offs. Joint processing reduced total runtime relative to independent reconstruction by avoiding repeated per-echo optimization, with larger savings for the 12-volume MTP datasets. However, processing multiple echoes concurrently increased peak memory. In these experiments, implicit reconstruction was more computationally demanding than explicit parameterization, but MIGA substantially reduced the runtime of independent implicit reconstruction while maintaining competitive reconstruction quality. MIGA therefore offers a favorable balance between reconstruction quality and computational efficiency.
blocks.zh: 表四汇总了计算权衡结果。 与独立重建相比,联合处理减少了总运行时间,避免了重复的每个echo优化,为12卷的中期计划数据集节省了更大的资金。 然而,处理多个回声同时增加了峰值内存. 在这些实验中,暗含重建比明确的参数化更需要计算,但MIGA在保持竞争性重建质量的同时,大幅度缩短了独立暗含重建的运行时间. 因此,MIGA在重建质量和计算效率之间提供了有利的平衡。

blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: V-A Reconstruction Performance Analysis
blocks.zh: V-A 重建绩效分析

blocks.en: MIGA achieved the best retrospective results for both CMRA and MTP at 12 × 12\times and 16 × 16\times acceleration (Table II ), with a more pronounced advantage for six-echo MTP under stronger undersampling. These results demonstrate its effectiveness in modeling complex echo-dependent variation under highly undersampled conditions. MIGA also produced visually high-quality reconstructions for the prospectively acquired MTP data (Fig. 5 ), supporting its feasibility in practical prospective acquisition settings.
blocks.zh: MIGA在12x12x12\时间和16x16x16时间的加速度上都取得了CMRA和MTP的最佳追溯结果(表二),在更强的采样下对6echo MTP具有更显著的优势. 这些结果表明,在高度受试条件下,它有效地模拟了复杂的依赖回声的变异。 多边投资担保机构还为预期获得的中期计划数据(图5)进行了视觉上高质量的重建,支持了在实际的预期采购环境中的可行性。

blocks.en: The observed performance reflects the complementary roles of shared Gaussian geometry and implicit amplitude modeling. Local anisotropic Gaussian primitives provide spatially adaptive support for 3D anatomy, while shared positions, scales, and rotations capture structural information common to aligned echoes. The multi-output network maps Gaussian centers to echo-wise amplitudes, introducing spatial and cross-echo coupling, while explicit echo-specific phase variables preserve complex signal variation.
blocks.zh: 观测到的性能反映了共享高斯几何和隐含振幅模型的互补作用. 局部异构高斯原始为3D解剖学提供空间适应支持,而共享位置,尺度,旋转则捕捉到对齐回声常见的结构信息. 多输出网络映射高斯亚中心,以回声智能振幅,引入空间和跨echo耦合,而明确的回声特定相位变量则保留复杂的信号变异.

blocks.en: The ablation results reveal a trade-off between echo-specific capacity and cross-echo regularization. For two-echo CMRA, the limited inter-echo variation was effectively represented by shared geometry and joint amplitude prediction. For six-echo MTP, independent reconstruction assigned a complete geometry and network to each echo, providing greater aggregate and per-echo representation capacity and yielding better performance at 12 × 12\times and higher SSIM at 16 × 16\times . Nevertheless, MIGA achieved comparable PSNR and NRMSE at 16 × 16\times , consistent with the increasing value of cross-echo constraints under stronger undersampling. Future work could retain shared geometry while expanding the amplitude model through a shared backbone with grouped or lightweight echo-specific branches, providing greater representation capacity for datasets with more echoes and more complex spatial variation.
blocks.zh: 减价结果表明,在回声能力与跨生态规范化之间存在着权衡。 对于双echo CMRA, 有限的间echo变异通过共享几何学和联合振幅预测得到有效体现. 对于6-echo MTP,独立重建为每个回声分配了一个完整的几何和网络,提供了更大的总和/echo代表能力,并在12×12时和16×16时提高了SSIM的性能. 然而,MIGA在16×16\时实现了类似的PSNR和NRMSE,这与在更强的取样下跨生态约束值的增加是一致的。 今后的工作可以保留共享几何,同时通过一个具有分组或轻量级回声特定分支的共享骨干,扩大振幅模型,为具有更多回声和更复杂的空间变异的数据集提供更大的代表能力.

blocks.en: V-B Effect of Gaussian Initialization Density
blocks.zh: V-B 高斯初始化密度的影响

blocks.en: TABLE V: Effect of Gaussian initialization density on reconstruction accuracy and computational cost for one two-echo CMRA dataset and one six-volume MTP reconstruction group at 12 × 12\times and 16 × 16\times acceleration. The best value in each accuracy and cost column within each dataset and acceleration block is shown in bold.
blocks.zh: 表五:高斯初始化密度对重建精度和计算成本的影响 1个双echo CMRA数据集和1个6卷的MTP重建组,时间为12×12\时,16×16x16时. 每个数据集和加速块内每个精度和成本栏中的最佳值以粗体表示。

blocks.en: Table V shows the trade-off between representation density, reconstruction accuracy, and computational cost. Increasing the grid step from 3 to 5 reduced the number of Gaussian primitives by approximately 78 % 78\% . Reconstruction quality decreased monotonically as the initialization became sparser, while total runtime decreased, confirming that denser spatial support improves local structure recovery at additional computational cost.
blocks.zh: 表五显示代表密度、重建精确度和计算成本之间的权衡。 将格子阶从3级提升到5级,将高斯原始人的数量减少了约78% 78\%. 重建质量单调下降,因为初始化变得比较稀疏,而总运行时间则减少,这证实了空间支持密度的提高能以额外的计算成本改善局部结构的恢复.

blocks.en: The sensitivity to initialization density differed between tasks. CMRA showed only small accuracy reductions as the grid became sparser, together with a substantial decrease in runtime. In contrast, MTP exhibited larger quality degradation for comparatively modest time savings, suggesting that six-echo reconstruction benefits more from dense shared spatial support. Peak memory changed little with Gaussian count, indicating that it was dominated by full-volume tensors and encoding operations rather than Gaussian parameters. Grid step 3 was therefore retained to prioritize reconstruction quality, particularly for MTP.
blocks.zh: 初始化密度的敏感性因任务而异. 由于电网越来越少,而且运行时间大幅度减少,CMRA的准确度下降很小。 相比之下,中期计划在质量方面出现较大的退化,节省的时间相对较少,这表明六小类重建更多地得益于密集的共享空间支助。 峰值记忆随着高斯计数变化不大,表明其以全容量的测距器和编码操作而非高斯参数为主. 因此,保留了第3条网格步骤,以优先安排重建质量,特别是中期计划的质量。

blocks.en: V-C Computational Considerations
blocks.zh: V-C 计算考虑因素

blocks.en: TABLE VI: Computational costs of the compared methods on CMRA and MTP, averaged over acceleration factors of 12 × 12\times and 16 × 16\times .
blocks.zh: 表格 VI: 计算与CMRA和MTP比较方法的计算费用,平均比加速系数12×12和16×16。

blocks.en: Under the evaluated implementations, MIGA achieved higher reconstruction accuracy with shorter recorded runtime than ZS-SSL, ConvDecoder, and LRTFR (Table VI ). The runtime advantage was particularly pronounced for 12-volume MTP reconstruction, consistent with the reduced redundancy of shared geometry and joint amplitude modeling. INR was faster and required substantially less GPU memory through slice-wise processing, but produced lower reconstruction quality and lacked a unified 3D representation. PICS was executed on the CPU and was therefore not directly comparable in GPU efficiency. Overall, MIGA provided a favorable quality–efficiency balance among the joint 3D multi-echo methods.
blocks.zh: 在评价的执行中,MIGA的重建精度高于ZS-SSL、ConvDecoder和LRTFR的运行时间(表六)。 在12卷的中期计划重建中,运行时间优势特别明显,这与减少共用几何和联合振幅模型的冗余是一致的。 INR更快,通过切片处理需要的GPU内存要少得多,但产生了较低的重建质量,缺乏统一的3D代表. PICS是在CPU上执行的,因此在GPU的效率上并不直接可比. 总体而言,多边投资担保机构在联合立体多生态方法之间提供了一种有利的质量-效率平衡。

blocks.en: MIGA also required less GPU memory than the convolutional baselines and a similar amount to LRTFR. Despite using mixed precision, the 3D convolutional methods retained high memory demands from volumetric multi-echo feature processing. Joint reconstruction reduced cumulative runtime relative to independent reconstruction but increased peak memory because multiple volumes were processed concurrently (Table IV ). Reducing Gaussian density produced little memory saving (Table V ), suggesting that peak allocation was dominated by full-volume image, k-space, and encoding operations rather than Gaussian parameters. Further memory reductions may therefore require memory-efficient encoding or chunked coil and echo processing rather than simply reducing the number of Gaussian primitives.
blocks.zh: MIGA也要求GPU内存少于演化基线,并且与LRTFR类似. 尽管使用了混合精度,但3D演化方法仍然保留了来自量子多echo特性处理的高内存需求. 与独立重建相比,联合重建减少了累计运行时间,但因同时处理多个卷而增加了峰值内存(表四)。 降低高斯密度产生的内存保存很少(表五),说明峰值分配以全音量图像,k空间,编码操作而不是高斯参数为主. 因此,进一步的内存减少可能需要内存高效编码或块化的线圈和回声处理,而不是简单地减少高斯原始人的数量.

blocks.en: V-D Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 限制和未来的工作

blocks.en: This study included three retrospective datasets per task and one prospective MTP dataset, limiting evaluation of intersubject, scanner, and protocol variability. Because no fully sampled prospective reference was available, prospective results were assessed visually. Larger multi-center studies should include expert evaluation, repeatability analysis, and task-specific endpoints such as coronary vessel depiction and quantitative MTP mapping.
blocks.zh: 这项研究包括每个任务的三个追溯数据集和一个可能的中期计划数据集,限制了对主体间、扫描仪和协议可变性的评价。 由于没有经过充分抽样的预期参考,因此对预期结果进行了目视评估。 较大的多中心研究应当包括专家评价,可重复性分析,以及冠状容器描绘和定量中期计划绘图等任务特定终点.

blocks.en: MIGA assumes aligned echoes with shared anatomical support. Motion, pronounced contrast variation, and the separate reconstruction of two six-echo MTP groups may limit information sharing; motion-aware models and hierarchical group- or echo-specific components merit investigation. MIGA also requires scan-specific optimization and substantial GPU memory. The weak dependence of peak memory on Gaussian density indicates that full-volume encoding and data consistency are the main bottlenecks. Chunked coil and echo processing, blockwise or multi-resolution optimization, memory-efficient data consistency, and adaptive Gaussian refinement may improve scalability.
blocks.zh: MIGA假设与共享解剖学支持一致的回声. 动议、显著的对比变异以及两个六Echo MTP小组的单独重建可能限制信息共享;运动意识模型和分级的团体或回声特定组成部分值得调查。 MIGA还需要扫描特定的优化和实质性的GPU内存. 峰值内存对高斯密度的依赖度微弱,表明全容量编码和数据一致性是主要瓶颈. 断层线圈和回声处理,阻断或多分辨率优化,内存效率高的数据一致性,适应性的高斯改进可以提高可扩展性.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: We proposed MIGA, a scan-specific framework for accelerated 3D multi-echo MRI reconstruction. MIGA combines shared anisotropic Gaussian geometry with implicit echo-dependent amplitude modeling and explicit echo-specific phase variables, separating common anatomical structure from flexible complex appearance. Experiments demonstrated consistent improvements over the comparison methods, while ablation studies supported the complementary roles of geometry sharing, structured amplitude modeling, and spatial regularization. MIGA also provided a favorable balance between reconstruction quality and computational cost among the evaluated full-volume methods. Overall, these findings demonstrate the effectiveness of combining shared geometric support with structured echo-dependent appearance modeling for undersampled 3D multi-echo MRI reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 我们提出MIGA,一个加速3D多echo核磁共振重建的扫描专用框架. MIGA将共享的异构高斯几何学与隐含的依赖回声的振幅模型和明确的回声特定相位变量结合起来,将共同解剖结构与灵活的复杂外观区分开来. 实验表明,比较方法有连贯一致的改进,而消化研究则支持几何共享、结构化振幅模型和空间规范化的互补作用。 多边投资担保机构在重建质量和被评价的全部数量方法的计算费用之间也取得了有利的平衡。 总的来说,这些调查结果表明,将共享几何支持与结构化的依赖回声的外观模型结合起来,对3D多电子磁共振重建进行抽样调查是有效的。
